name: coding-harness
description: An in-editor coding agent. Give it a prompt and it plans, reads, searches, edits files and runs commands in your workspace using a sandboxed tool set.

commands.title: Coding Harness: Revert Changes From Last Task
Coding Harness: Set API Key (stored in Secret Storage)

enumDescriptions: Any OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions endpoint (OpenAI, OpenRouter, Groq, Together, vLLM, Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp server).
Offline rule-based planner. No API key, no network. Useful to smoke-test the harness and to demo the tool loop.
codingHarness.provider.markdownDescription: Which model backend the harness talks to. Use `mock` for a zero-config offline demo.

codingHarness.baseUrl.markdownDescription: Base URL of the API. Examples: `https://api.openai.com/v1`, `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1`, `http://localhost:11434/v1` (Ollama), `http://localhost:1234/v1` (LM Studio), `https://api.anthropic.com`.

codingHarness.apiKey.markdownDescription: API key. Prefer the **Coding Harness: Set API Key** command, which stores it in VS Code secret storage instead of settings. The env vars `HARNESS_API_KEY` / `OPENAI_API_KEY` / `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` are used as a fallback.

codingHarness.maxSteps.description: Maximum model turns (each turn may run several tools) before the task is stopped.

codingHarness.editPolicy.markdownDescription: `ask`: every file write / delete shows a diff and needs approval. `auto`: the agent applies edits directly (every change is still checkpointed and can be reverted).

codingHarness.commandPolicy.markdownDescription: How shell commands are gated. `auto-safe` runs known read-only commands silently and asks for everything else. `ask` asks for all commands. `auto-all` runs everything that is not on the hard deny-list. `deny-all` disables the shell tool.

codingHarness.allowDangerousCommands.markdownDescription: Disable the hard deny-list (e.g. `rm -rf /`, `mkfs`, `dd of=/dev/*`, `curl | sh`). Leave this off unless you really know what you are doing.

codingHarness.commandTimeoutMs.description: Default timeout for shell commands run by the agent.

codingHarness.allowOutsideWorkspace.markdownDescription: Allow the file tools to read and write outside the workspace folder. Off by default; the tools otherwise refuse any path that escapes the workspace root (including via symlinks).

codingHarness.maxFileBytes.description: Files larger than this are not read or scanned by the tools (bytes).

codingHarness.includeDiagnosticsInPrompt.markdownDescription: Send a compact snapshot of current workspace problems (VS Code diagnostics) with each task, so the agent knows what is already broken.

codingHarness.stream.markdownDescription: Render model output token by token while it is produced. Turn off for endpoints that do not support server-sent events (the harness then falls back to a single response per turn).

codingHarness.showThinking.markdownDescription: Show the model's reasoning stream in its own lane when the backend provides one (DeepSeek `reasoning_content`, OpenRouter `reasoning`, OpenAI-compatible reasoning models, Anthropic extended thinking). The reasoning is displayed only — it is never sent back to the model as conversation content.

codingHarness.systemPromptExtra.markdownDescription: Extra instructions appended to the system prompt (project conventions, preferred commands, style rules, …).

codingHarness.mcp.enabled.markdownDescription: Enable Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers. When enabled, tools from configured MCP servers are added to the agent's tool set.

codingHarness.mcp.servers.markdownDescription: MCP servers configuration. Each key is a server ID, value is an object with `command` (required), `args` (optional array), `env` (optional object), `cwd` (optional), `disabled` (optional boolean), `timeoutMs` (optional number). Example: `{"my-server": {"command": "node", "args": ["./mcp-server.js"]}}`

codingHarness.mcp.timeoutMs.markdownDescription: Default timeout for MCP tool calls (ms).

codingHarness.compaction.enabled.markdownDescription: Enable conversation compaction to manage context window usage.

codingHarness.compaction.autoCompact.markdownDescription: Automatically compact the conversation when it approaches the context window limit.

codingHarness.compaction.threshold.markdownDescription: Context utilization threshold (0-1) at which auto-compaction triggers. 0.75 = compact when 75% of context window is used.

codingHarness.compaction.contextWindowTo.markdownDescription: Estimated context window size in tokens. Used to calculate utilization percentage. Adjust based on your model (e.g., 128k for gpt-4o, 200k for Claude).

codingHarness.compaction.keepLastMessage.markdownDescription: Number of recent messages to keep uncompacted when compaction occurs.
